source: Uganda Revenue Authority, PAYE rates for resident taxpayers (https://ura.go.ug/en/domestic-taxes/paye-rates/), read 2026-11-05, after the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026. Monthly: nil to 335,000; 20% of the excess over 335,000 to 410,000; 15,000 + 25% of the excess over 410,000 to 485,000; 33,750 + 30% of the excess over 485,000 to 10,000,000; above 10,000,000 an extra 10% of the excess over 10,000,000 (a marginal 40%). Written here as annual bands (12 times the monthly ones). Commencement 1 July 2026 is from a URA notice and law-firm and PwC summaries (e.g. https://www.kaa.co.ug/kaa-tax-alert-income-tax-amendment-act-2026/); the gazetted Act was not read. Not modelled: non-residents (the URA page shows a different table) and employees with more than one employer, who are taxed at a flat 30% of total employment income.
